subjects.label: Getting stuck and recovering
subjects.description: Being bogged in mud or a swamp, tipping the truck over and getting out again by winch or recovery, recounted as a recurring event of play; not the fidelity of the mud simulation itself, which is terrain physics.

subjects.label: Mud, water and terrain physics
subjects.description: How mud, water, snow, rocks and vehicle weight are simulated and whether the driving model is a convincing simulation or feels arcade; not the vehicles themselves or the act of getting stuck.

subjects.label: Gearbox and pedal behaviour
subjects.description: How the transmission shifts and how the pedals behave, including the lack of a manual gearbox and braking that drops the truck into reverse; not menus, keybindings or general controller support.

subjects.label: Trucks and the vehicle roster
subjects.description: Which trucks and vehicles are in the game, favourite models and brands, requests for specific vehicles, and their upgrades and customisation; not how they handle on the terrain.

subjects.label: Maps and regions
subjects.description: The named regions and maps, how they compare with one another, whether they are faithful to the real places they are named after, and the scale of the open world; not the trucks or the physics.

subjects.label: Cargo hauling and route planning
subjects.description: Long hauls delivering cargo across the map, working out a route from A to B, trusting or distrusting a shortcut, and the satisfaction of completing a contract; not getting stuck along the way.

subjects.label: Slow, meditative pace
subjects.description: Playing it as a calming, unhurried, anti-stress experience, with an audiobook on or the mind wandering, and accepting that it demands time; not the frustration it also produces.

subjects.label: Frustration and rage
subjects.description: The frustration, nerves and rage the game provokes, cursing the regions, the obstacles and the developer while still coming back for more; not a complaint about difficulty settings or a plain negative verdict.

subjects.label: Predecessors in the series
subjects.description: How it compares with the earlier games in its own line, what each entry fixed or broke, and what the next instalment should be; not comparisons with games outside the series.
